Marigold Group, Inc. is hiring an Associate Software Engineer for the Emma engineering team. The role builds and ships customer-focused software for email marketing tools, collaborates on code quality, and contributes across frontend and backend development while growing technical skills.
Enterprise Software
Marketing
CRM
Digital Marketing
Email Marketing
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Build and ship code that solves real problems for real customers. Engineering is central to what we do, and you’ll work closely with your team to plan, experiment, and deliver impactful solutions
Collaborate in code reviews, sharing ideas, learning from others, and helping raise the bar on quality and best practices
Get hands-on with how Emma builds intuitive, scalable tooling that helps marketing teams do their best work
Have fun while doing it!  We care deeply about our customers, move with intention, and genuinely enjoy building great products together
Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to research, prototype, and build, while learning how to apply them responsibly in a production codebase
Qualification
React
Python
AWS
GitHub Copilot
Claude
Required
You're an early-career developer who's excited to learn, grow, and contribute as part of a collaborative engineering team
While you may not be a master of React, Python, or AWS yet, you bring curiosity, strong potential, and a genuine desire to build your skills and learn best practices
You care deeply about technology, the products you help create, and the customers who rely on them
You enjoy variety in your work, are eager to take on new challenges, and are motivated by opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow alongside a supportive team
You're comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and you know that good engineering still means understanding, questioning, and owning the code you ship
Early-career developer or recent graduate with a strong interest in software engineering
Foundational experience or exposure to modern technologies such as React, Python, AWS, or similar tools
Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices
Passion for building quality products with the end user in mind
Comfortable working across different areas of the codebase and contributing where needed
Strong collaboration skills and openness to feedback and continuous improvement
Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up your work, and able to critically review, test, and own the code they help produce
Preferred
Experience in any of these areas is a plus
